source: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki Farming (Crops table), Mining (Mining XP Table), Foraging (Blocks table), fetched 2026-11-25
note: Skill XP is given per block broken, not per item (wiki Farming note; the Mining and Foraging tables are per block too), so XP per item = XP per block / (base items per block x (1 + fortune/100)). Fortune per bracket matches the collection rate brackets in rate-defaults.json. Base drops are 1 unless listed; the wiki pages don't state them, so listed ones are vanilla or community values and say so. Items with no XP on these tables (Hard Stone, Umber, Tungsten, Glacite, Sulphur, Mycelium, Red Sand, fishing and mob drops) get no gathering combo.

farming.basis: rate-defaults FARMING: <100 fortune early, ~300 mid, ~1,400 late

mining.basis: rate-defaults MINING: low fortune early, x~3 drops mid, x~10 late (gemstones)

foraging.basis: estimate: Foraging Fortune from axes, armor and pets

baseBasis.farming: base drops per crop as farming-fortune calculators use them (not on the wiki)
baseBasis.mining: vanilla Minecraft drop count (not on the wiki)

gardenMilestones.basis: crops farmed in the Garden count toward the crop's milestone; test/fixtures show milestone counts at or above the collection for every crop (ducksterr_, 2026-11-25), so 1 per item is a floor

slayerSource: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki boss pages (Revenant_Horror, Tarantula_Broodfather, Sven_Packmaster, Voidgloom_Seraph, Inferno_Demonlord), Spawning tables, fetched 2026-11-24 (after the 0.27.2 change to Combat XP required)
slayerNote: Primary is the boss's slayer XP. Each boss needs this much Combat XP from mobs before it spawns, so Combat XP per slayer XP = Combat XP required / slayer XP for the tier the rate bracket assumes (rate-defaults slayerXp: early T3, mid T4, late T5, or T4 where T5 is missing or Alpha-only). XP from the boss kill itself is not counted, so these are floors. Where the usual spawn grind is one mob (Crypt Ghouls, Pack Spirits, Zealots, Blazes), its kills and guaranteed drops are counted too: kills per slayer XP = Combat XP per slayer XP / the mob's Combat XP (data/sources/wiki-mobs.json). Tarantula has no single usual mob, so it counts Combat XP only.

slayer.name: Revenant Horror quests
slayer.basis: Combat XP to spawn / slayer XP: T3 2,500/100, T4 5,000/500, T5 10,000/1,500
